title: The Human Core | ECHO//100 Episode 27
description: Kavi discovers a girl trapped within the Spire's heart, fueling the city's existence. He must decide if the price of her freedom is worth the destruction of their world. Episode 27 of ECHO//100: ARC. This is an AI-assisted original fiction work.

scenes.text: The pulsing purple Null-glitch devours Kavi’s arm until Mira’s warm palm halts the corruption.
scenes.caption: Mira touches Kavi
scenes.image_prompt: Kavi in his red hoodie and glasses reaching out to a human-looking Mira in a teal coat, purple glitch energy receding from his arm, inside a glowing crystalline spire core.

scenes.text: Mira is no mere code, but a living prisoner shackled to the Archive’s central core.
scenes.caption: Mira is trapped
scenes.image_prompt: Mira looking exhausted, connected to glowing blue data-cables that snake into the spire walls, while Kavi watches in horror.

scenes.text: Byte scans the floor, projecting a warning that the Archive reboot seals them inside forever.
scenes.caption: Byte detects danger
scenes.image_prompt: Byte the floating white robot with a cyan face and orange antenna hovering near a massive glowing countdown clock on the wall.

scenes.text: Kavi pulls the shimmering cables free, causing the Spire to scream as reality unspools rapidly.
scenes.caption: Disconnecting the core
scenes.image_prompt: Kavi ripping glowing blue cables from the wall, causing the room to shake and walls to dissolve into digital shards.

scenes.text: The city’s structural integrity remains tethered to her heartbeat; her departure ensures total systemic collapse.
scenes.caption: The fatal cost
scenes.image_prompt: Kavi looking at a holographic map of the city flickering out of existence as Mira gasps in pain.

scenes.text: Freeing Mira requires murdering the home, as breaking these golden chains shatters the entire timeline.
scenes.caption: The impossible reversal
scenes.image_prompt: Close up of Kavi's face, eyes wide behind his glasses, reflecting a collapsing digital city skyline.

scenes.text: Null emerges from the static, eyes burning red, demanding Kavi choose between her life and theirs.
scenes.caption: Null demands choice
scenes.image_prompt: A shadowy figure with black-purple glitch skin and glowing red eyes standing between Kavi and the exit.

scenes.text: Kavi reaches for the power switch, knowing saving Mira will delete the city forever today.
scenes.caption: The final decision
scenes.image_prompt: Kavi hovering his hand over a glowing red terminal, with Mira behind him and Null looming in the dark background.
